author: freeCodeCamp.org
description:
Build a complete top-down action roguelite in Godot 4, from an empty project to a game a stranger can open and play. About 10 hours, 8 chapters, 31 lessons. Most lessons stop for a Your Turn, where you build the next piece yourself before you see mine.

➡️ Try the demo (no account, ~2 min): https://codingquests.io/roguelike?utm_source=freecodecamp&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=fcc_2d_roguelike&utm_content=description

What you need
- Godot 4.7.2, the standard version (not .NET). Anything from 4.6 on works: https://godotengine.org/download/archive/4.7.2-stable/
- The Assets folder (art and sound, used from lesson 0.1). It comes with the starting project: https://github.com/CodingQuests/2D-Roguelike-Tutorial-youtube/archive/refs/heads/lesson-0.1.zip
- The project at the end of every lesson: https://github.com/CodingQuests/2D-Roguelike-Tutorial-youtube
  Each lesson is a branch. Pick the lesson before the one you're starting, then Code - Download ZIP.
- The finished game, to play first:
title: Godot 4 Roguelike Course – Build a Complete Top-Down Action Game
